name: bg-media
blurb: Displays an image or video background with optional overlay.
description: Flexible media background component accepting image or video source. Applies configurable overlay (none, light, dark) using ::before pseudo-element for visual dimming.
use_when: Hero section with full-bleed video or image requiring overlay for text contrast.
avoid_when: When media auto-play would violate user preferences or battery concerns.
a11y: Requires alt text for images; video requires controls or prefers-reduced-motion support.
